issues.title: [R0][EPIC-01] Secured platform foundation
issues.body:
## Outcome

Secured platform foundation, following the approved implementation master plan.

## Epic and stories

EPIC-01: STORY-001, STORY-002, STORY-003, STORY-004, STORY-005

## Requirements

FR-ADM-001, FR-ADM-002, FR-ADM-003, FR-ADM-009, FR-APP-010, NFR-AVL-001, NFR-MNT-001, NFR-MNT-002, NFR-MNT-004, NFR-MNT-005, NFR-PORT-001, NFR-PORT-002, NFR-PORT-004, NFR-SEC-001, NFR-SEC-003, NFR-SEC-004, NFR-SEC-005, NFR-SEC-010, TR-API-001, TR-AUTH-001, TR-AUTH-002, TR-AUTH-003, TR-DATA-003, TR-DEP-001, TR-DEP-003, TR-STACK-001, TR-STACK-002, TR-STACK-003, TR-STACK-004, TR-STACK-005, TR-TEST-001, TR-TEST-002

## Applicable ADRs

ADR-001 through ADR-010; dependency selections in the foundation adoption register.

## Scope

- Initialize TypeScript monorepo: Create pnpm workspace with web, API, worker and shared packages.
- Create PostgreSQL schema foundation: Create customer, identity, project, connector and audit foundations with migrations.
- Create containerized local environment: Provide reference Docker Compose, health checks and synthetic seed.
- Establish CI and documentation validation: Run lint, typecheck, tests, build and requirements validation.
- Implement foundation security controls: Enforce production OIDC validation, scoped grants/revocation and encrypted secrets before real data; constrain local identity to synthetic development.

## Out of scope

Other increments, customer-specific forks, production data in tests, unsupported commercial claims and unapproved external side effects.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC-ADM-001: An administrator can configure OIDC metadata and map an identity group to an application role without code changes.
- [ ] AC-AUTH-001: Trusted OIDC identity succeeds with configured user/group mapping; invalid signature, issuer, audience and expired tokens/sessions are denied. Development login is disabled in production and constrained to synthetic local data.
- [ ] AC-AUTH-002: An authorized administrator can grant/revoke portfolio and project access. Direct API/service/query access denies cross-project reads/writes, revoked memberships and operational administrators without explicit business scope.
- [ ] AC-DATA-001: A clean PostgreSQL database can apply the initial versioned migration and create customer, identity, project, connector and audit foundations.
- [ ] AC-DEP-001: The documented OCI container composition starts web/API, worker and PostgreSQL and passes readiness checks without a mandatory vendor-operated service or control plane.
- [ ] AC-DEP-002: The same application can connect to a supported external PostgreSQL instance without product-code changes.
- [ ] AC-FND-001: The pnpm TypeScript workspace builds web, NestJS API and worker applications; domain package boundaries have no cycles or external SDK leakage, and API routes publish a generated, runtime-validated OpenAPI contract.
- [ ] AC-MNT-002: A PR fails CI for failed lint, typecheck, the chosen Vitest suite, build or documentation validation; critical implemented browser journeys run through Playwright and also gate the PR.
- [ ] AC-MNT-004: CI/release review rejects unregistered runtime packages, incompatible or unknown licenses, missing exact lockfile inventory or notices, and missing dependency/container vulnerability scans; a release includes SBOM and documented vulnerability dispositions.
- [ ] AC-SEC-001: Credential storage contains authenticated ciphertext or approved secret references; missing/wrong keys and modified ciphertext fail closed. Logs, API errors, browser responses and nonsecret configuration exports reveal no secret. Secrets and nonsecrets are configured separately.
- [ ] AC-SEC-002: The customer deployment terminates browser TLS at approved ingress and verifies external certificate chains; invalid certificates fail closed. Local loopback HTTP is documented as synthetic-development-only.
- [ ] AC-SEC-003: The shared dispatcher defaults to shadow mode and blocks every external action unless an explicit current policy permits it. Invalid configuration and production development identity fail closed; callers cannot bypass the guard through a model tool. Foundation denial tests use a recording adapter and prove zero dispatches while blocked.

## Required tests

CI-FND-001, CI-MNT-002, CI-MNT-004, DEP-001, DEP-002, INT-ADM-001, INT-DATA-001, SEC-AUTH-001, SEC-AUTH-002, SEC-OUTBOUND-003, SEC-SECRET-001, SEC-TLS-001

Run applicable lint, typecheck, unit/integration, build, Playwright and documentation validation. Planned test IDs are not passing evidence.

## Dependencies

Baseline Issue #1 and reviewed master plan.

## Security impact

Enforce current identity/scope and action policy on every boundary; maintain redaction, evidence permissions and human approval.

## Database impact

Use versioned additive migrations behind repository interfaces; test clean/repeat deployment and documented recovery for any schema change.

## Connector impact

No live connector scopes until specifically configured and approved. Contract fixtures and synthetic data are the CI default; R1 Jira writes remain comment-only.

## Definition of Done

All applicable criteria have executable/manual evidence; separate non-author review identifies final candidate SHA, required remote checks pass, PR merges, traceability/status are updated and rollback is documented.

- Implement contextual request generator: Build focused messages from current facts and missing information.
- Implement secure response page: Allow authenticated or tokenized response, structured choices and free text.
- Implement reminder and escalation jobs: Use Graphile Worker, quiet hours, duplicate suppression and PM escalation.

## Out of scope

Other increments, customer-specific forks, production data in tests, unsupported commercial claims and unapproved external side effects.

- [ ] AC-UPD-003: An expired, invalid or unauthorized response link cannot submit or reveal project information.
- [ ] AC-UPD-004: A valid free-text reply produces schema-valid proposed facts and does not directly write to Jira.
- [ ] AC-UPD-006: Confirmation commits satisfied fact state and reminder suppression atomically, independent of delayed or failed optional Jira write-back. Workers recheck current state before sending; unresolved facts retain clarification actions.
- [ ] AC-UPD-007: A reminder becoming due during quiet hours is deferred to the next allowed time and the reason is recorded.
- [ ] AC-UPD-008: After the configured unanswered stages, the PM receives the original request, reminder history, missing facts and project impact.
- [ ] AC-UPD-009: A configured PM, lead or contributor owner can submit/correct their own free-text or configured-choice response through recipient-bound authenticated access. Another user or expired link is denied. Approved email notification includes the secure route; shadow suppresses sends and ambiguous delivery outcomes require safe recovery.
- [ ] AC-UPD-010: An authorized administrator sets stage delays/recipients/channels; weekday and quiet-hour scheduling uses valid IANA time zones. A response after escalation suppresses future satisfied-fact reminders; invalid time zones are rejected.

Interpretation and approved Jira comments, following the approved implementation master plan.

## Requirements

## Applicable ADRs

ADR-001 through ADR-010; dependency selections in the foundation adoption register.

## Scope

- Implement AI response extraction: Use provider abstraction and Zod schema to create proposed facts.
- Implement clarification and interpretation confirmation: Ask focused clarification and allow user correction.
- Implement approval diff and authority: Show consequences and enforce project-specific approver.
- Implement Jira comment write-back: Preflight, execute approved comment, retry safely and create receipt.
- Implement source-change conflict: Block execution when Jira changes after approval.

## Out of scope

Other increments, customer-specific forks, production data in tests, unsupported commercial claims and unapproved external side effects.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC-ADM-004: An administrator can select an approved provider or OpenAI-compatible private endpoint and test it without exposing the secret.
- [ ] AC-AI-001: Validate schema, scope, action class and audit policy on every model tool invocation. Malicious Jira text cannot call arbitrary SQL/URLs/connectors/email, expand scope, or approve a proposal even under a PM session; approval is absent from the model registry.
- [ ] AC-AI-002: The same validated extraction/claim contract runs through mock and approved alternate provider adapters without domain changes. Invalid schema/timeouts preserve responses for manual structuring. Pin and record provider/prompt/schema versions; deterministic CI fixtures require no live keys.
- [ ] AC-APP-001: A material Jira proposal displays target, current value, proposed value, source response, evidence, side effects and required approver.
- [ ] AC-APP-002: A user with read access but without approval authority cannot approve the proposal.
- [ ] AC-APP-003: An authorized reviewer can edit the proposed text or allowlisted value and the approved revision is retained.
- [ ] AC-APP-004: An expired proposal cannot execute without a new review or approval.
- [ ] AC-APP-005: If Jira changes between approval and execution, execution stops and a new diff is required.
- [ ] AC-APP-007: Retrying an already successful write does not create a duplicate comment or field change.
- [ ] AC-APP-008: Every write attempt records proposal, approver, execution identity, result, correlation ID and external revision or error class.
- [ ] AC-EVD-006: A confirmed response records the confirming user, timestamp, original response and linked evidence.
- [ ] AC-PRV-001: An administrator configures redaction and data-routing restrictions; captured adapter requests contain only necessary permitted content, disallowed provider/class routes are blocked, and operational storage remains customer-controlled. Provider no-training statements require recorded agreement evidence.
- [ ] AC-UPD-004: A valid free-text reply produces schema-valid proposed facts and does not directly write to Jira.
- [ ] AC-UPD-005: An ambiguous response creates a focused clarification request and no material fact or write proposal is approved automatically.
- [ ] AC-WRB-001: A human-approved allowlisted Jira comment posts with receipt; removed app/connector authority, unapproved revision, bulk material approval, arbitrary field writes, baseline/budget/contract changes or automatic issue completion are rejected before dispatch.
- [ ] AC-WRB-002: Lose the acknowledgement after the source commits a marked comment. Reconcile the exact target/marker/digest without duplication; incomplete lookup remains manual recovery. Known-safe failures use bounded classified retries; every attempt repeats expiry, authority, source, allowlist and mode checks.

## Out of scope

## Epic and stories

## Requirements

BR-001, BR-002, BR-003, BR-004, BR-005, BR-006, BR-008, BR-010, BR-011, BR-012, BR-013, BR-014, FR-ADM-008, FR-ADM-009, FR-APP-004, FR-APP-005, FR-APP-010, FR-AUD-001, FR-AUD-002, FR-AUD-003, FR-AUD-004, FR-AUD-005, FR-AUD-007, FR-CON-004, FR-CON-009, FR-CON-010, FR-CON-012, FR-HLT-001, FR-QA-001, FR-QA-009, FR-RPT-001, FR-RPT-004, FR-RPT-005, FR-RPT-007, FR-RPT-010, FR-UPD-001, FR-UPD-002, FR-WRB-003, FR-WRB-004, FR-WRB-007, NFR-AI-005, NFR-AVL-002, NFR-MNT-003, NFR-OBS-001, NFR-PORT-003, NFR-PRV-004, NFR-REL-001, NFR-REL-003, NFR-REL-004, NFR-SEC-005, NFR-SEC-007, NFR-SEC-008, NFR-SEC-009, PR-001, PR-002, PR-003, PR-004, PR-005, PR-006, PR-012, PR-013, PR-014, PR-015, TR-AI-002, TR-AI-004, TR-API-003, TR-DATA-002, TR-DEP-004, TR-STACK-008

## Applicable ADRs

ADR-001 through ADR-010; dependency selections in the foundation adoption register.

## Scope

- Implement audit and action-receipt search: Create append-only events and authorized search.
- Implement shadow mode: Verify and extend the foundation outbound guard with global, connector and action-class shadow administration and full workflow tests.
- Implement backup, restore and upgrade runbook: Package migrations, backup, restore and recovery validation.
- Run security and failure gates: Complete authorization, prompt injection, duplicate event and unknown-outcome tests.
- Prepare synthetic event demo: Seed portfolio, scripted delay, update interaction, approval and leadership Q&A.

## Out of scope

Other increments, customer-specific forks, production data in tests, unsupported commercial claims and unapproved external side effects.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC-AI-001: Validate schema, scope, action class and audit policy on every model tool invocation. Malicious Jira text cannot call arbitrary SQL/URLs/connectors/email, expand scope, or approve a proposal even under a PM session; approval is absent from the model registry.
- [ ] AC-APP-006: Global, connector and action-class shadow controls suppress every affected outbound message/write while retaining proposals and audit; read-only onboarding never writes to source systems.
- [ ] AC-APP-007: Retrying an already successful write does not create a duplicate comment or field change.
- [ ] AC-APP-008: Every write attempt records proposal, approver, execution identity, result, correlation ID and external revision or error class.
- [ ] AC-AUD-001: Authentication/configuration/agent/approval/connector events distinguish human, service and worker actors and correlate request/job/model/connector activity. Reject normal API audit edits/deletes. Record provider/model/prompt/schema versions, evidence IDs and structured input/tool/result summaries with redaction and without private chain-of-thought.
- [ ] AC-CON-004: Submitting the same webhook event twice produces one source observation and no duplicate downstream obligation.
- [ ] AC-CON-006: Expired credentials change connector health to failed or degraded and show a safe administrator-facing reason without exposing the secret.
- [ ] AC-DEP-003: A backup restores into a clean deployment with fact, workflow and audit consistency. Restores start outbound-disabled; a comment completed after the backup is reconciled by marker and never replayed. Failed migration stops upgrade and exercises documented recovery before resuming.
- [ ] AC-DEP-004: The reference deployment supports a no-AI mode in which synchronization, freshness, health and manual reporting remain available.
- [ ] AC-HLT-001: A project whose required update is older than policy is shown as stale and creates the configured obligation.
- [ ] AC-MNT-001: Two synthetic customer configurations with different mappings, terminology, cadence/escalation, health thresholds and report configuration run on the identical build with no customer branch or code edits; invalid configuration is rejected.
- [ ] AC-PIL-001: Record agreed baseline and observation windows, denominators, exclusions and PMO measurement owner. Synthetic fixtures verify aggregate chasing/reporting effort, fresh/completed updates and risk-detection lead time. Demonstrate improvement only from observed pilot results; never infer employee performance from response/activity counts.
- [ ] AC-PRO-001: The synthetic hero workflow retains Jira and the spreadsheet as source systems, normalizes a tool-neutral project, versions facts/evidence and applies field authority, detects missing/stale information, asks the correct owner a contextual question, and presents an evidence-backed answer without replacing project-management tools.
- [ ] AC-PRO-002: A single-tenant customer-hosted install uses its configured OIDC and approved AI endpoint, owns its data/secrets and operates without vendor control-plane credentials. Swap the approved endpoint without domain-code changes; no-AI mode remains useful.
- [ ] AC-PRV-002: Configured expiry for operational, evidence, AI and audit data applies by class with an auditable retention job; normal APIs cannot edit/delete retained material audit. Source removal triggers claim revalidation and no unauthorized content reappears from embeddings.
- [ ] AC-QA-001: An authorized leader can ask why a project is delayed and receive baseline, forecast, verified cause, action and uncertainty.
- [ ] AC-RPT-001: A dashboard snapshot, email preview and PowerPoint generated for one report run share the same fact-set revision.
- [ ] AC-RPT-002: A timestamped editable PowerPoint is generated on a clean host without Microsoft Office using approved server-side libraries, with report period, source freshness and approval state.
- [ ] AC-UPD-001: When an update becomes due, the request names the project, current known position and specific missing information.
